target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Reviewed ordinary control flow and scalar and vector numerical FP under explicit native block exits and serialized runtime dispatch. GuestState* arrives in RDI; the two-u64 BlockExit next_pc/kind returns in RAX/RDX. The nonwrapping, non-streaming profile enables FP/FP16/AFP, disables GCS, uses unguarded executable pages and private direct RAM. Numerical S/D common paths execute inline with preserved caller MXCSR; vectors evaluate only active lanes, clear the upper half for 64-bit shapes and aggregate sticky status transactionally. H and exceptional values complete through an immutable-source-validated kind-9 interior boundary. Any numerical exception enable declines before effects. SVC/BRK partially support a precise typed kind-5 boundary retaining kind, imm16 and preferred exception return PC; architectural exception entry is pending.
outside_scope: GCS, guarded-page BTI checks and PSTATE.BTYPE
disabled-FP access checks, streaming SME and numerical FP exception delivery
architectural exception delivery and asynchronous state reconstruction
privilege, MMU, devices and full ARM memory ordering
full process ABI, application loading and macOS boot

status_policy: Block and leaf counts are separate profile assessments of canonical forms. Nine forms overlap; counts must not be added. No Apple ISA or compatibility denominator is established.

forms.review: Reviewed ordinary transfer decoding and native BlockExit emission against the linked original-A64/native/Rust-dispatch suite. Smoke binds the first-terminator prefix and ABI; it does not execute the block.
forms.scope: Ordinary control transfer returns the next guest PC and exit kind to serialized dispatch, with X30=PC+4 for calls and original-target capture for BLR X30. Conditional transfers preserve guest NZCV. Guest address arithmetic must not wrap. GCS is disabled and executable pages are unguarded; no PAC, PSTATE.BTYPE or exception delivery is claimed.

forms.review: Exact pinned imm16 encoding and state-preserving trap-boundary emission reviewed against original ARM interrupt observations, independent prefix/state math, raw native tuples and Rust dispatch. Rejection samples check neighboring exception classes, not full exception-delivery semantics.
forms.scope: Partial: stop at the original instruction PC with preserved modeled GPR/SP/NZCV/reserved state, class and imm16. Preferred exception return is PC+4 for SVC and PC for BRK. No EL/PSTATE transition, vector dispatch, ESR/SPSR/ELR register update, syscall service or host trap is implemented. Input code extents remain nonwrapping; leaf compilation declines.

forms.review: Exact June canonical forms and reserved ftype reviewed with original QEMU result/status captures, complete-state ordinary-control Unicorn checks, actual native block exits and Rust runtime/cache/budget completion. Baseline SSE2 and checked-host output agree; emitted bodies and mapping performance are recorded in the numerical FP native receipt.
forms.scope: Enabled FP/FP16/AFP, non-streaming scalar H/S/D arithmetic with all operand aliases, NEP upper bits from original Vn, Arm NaN/flushing/rounding/tininess behavior and sticky FPSR. Normal S/D operations can continue inline; H and exceptional values complete through the precise shared integer-core helper. Every exception-enable bit declines before this instruction changes state. No enabled trap delivery, disabled-FP access checks, streaming SME, numerical leaf ABI or complete process execution is claimed.

forms.review: Exact June canonical forms, all 20 arrangements and reserved 1D encodings are reviewed. Actual vector originals supply full-frame QEMU captures; raw completed native paths receive direct-original equality credit, while unchanged helper exits and actual Rust helper completion are checked separately. Emitted binaries, caller MXCSR and runtime control/status, cache and budget resumes are retained in the consolidated numerical evidence.
forms.scope: Enabled FP/FP16/AFP, AArch64, non-streaming vector binary arithmetic: 4H/8H, 2S/4S and 2D, every V-register role and source/destination alias. Evaluate active lanes only; 64-bit vector writes clear the upper half regardless of NEP. Reuse shared Arm lane NaN/flushing/rounding/tininess semantics, aggregate sticky FPSR transactionally and preserve other CPU/RAM state. Normal S/D paths execute inline; H and exceptional values use the immutable-source-validated shared integer-core boundary. Any numerical exception enable declines before destination/status effects. No numerical trap delivery, disabled-FP access, streaming SME, numerical leaf ABI or complete application execution is claimed.
